caption:
Singapore grew six times over and greyed at the same time. In 2021, seniors overtook children.

Watch the base stop widening after the Stop at Two campaign of 1972, watch the city fill up in the middle rather than at the bottom, and watch the boom generation reach sixty.

📊 See Singapore's population by age and sex from 1950 to 2023 in this animated pyramid, in thousands. Explore how a million people became six million without the base ever widening again, and what an ageing city-state actually looks like.

Source: UN World Population Prospects 2024, Population Division, UN DESA — population by 5-year age groups and sex, medium variant.
